description:
Documentation/metadata-only cleanup of truth defects the adversarial holistic
review found in already-merged DONE items. No source-code behavior changes. Each
is an honesty fix so a reader of "Completed" is not misled:

  - #909 (plan-capture-robustness-hardening) DONE YAML scope_limit.only_modify
    omits benchbox/core/plan_capture_phase.py, which the diff legitimately touched
    and which the item's own prior_art names as a w3 target. Scope-list narrower
    than the task's intent.
  - #914 (structural-debt) DONE YAML w1 success_metric overstates "no literal TPC
    names in execution.py dispatch" (true only for the power path). Reword to the
    accurate power-path-only claim and cross-link the refactor follow-up
    (execution-harness-extraction-throughput-maintenance-combined) that will
    restore the full claim.
  - #906 (gate-target-ci-ratchet) Makefile:222-237 comments still call clickbench
    and joinorder-synthetic "Report-mode (STAGED gate)... not a blocking CI gate
    yet", but both are in GATES, STAGED_GATES is empty, and both run in the
    blocking correctness-gate (pr.yml). Stale comments contradict enforcement.
  - #906 close-out discipline: the guard's required-CI wiring (pr.yml:398) landed
    in #908, not #906 — #906 merged a non-load-bearing guard. Add a one-line house
    rule so a guard and its CI wiring land together, and verify no unpinned-gate
    window existed between the two merges.
